title: KKKKhazix/AIHOT
why_read: A customizable framework for building a self-updating industry news site, written in Chinese and TypeScript, could interest engineers building similar aggregation tools.
analysis: This GitHub project provides a framework for automatically scraping sources and generating a daily digest website, letting the user swap in their own sources and curation criteria. It is essentially a templated pipeline for building niche news aggregators, likely using some LLM-based summarization given the 'self-writing' daily report framing. The high star count suggests decent community traction, though the lack of English documentation limits the audience. Technically it's a reasonably common pattern (scrape + LLM summarize + publish) rather than a novel breakthrough.
